vetSays.line: 🛡️ Gilberto, the person in their 50s, with thick glasses, Otis and Daniyar met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Gilberto, Otis, Daniyar are hurt.
🛡️ Roman, Gilberto, Fabián and Otis met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Gilberto, Fabián, Otis are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Gilberto strikes the Elder Old Gavel.
The Elder Old Gavel falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Old Gavel!
📺 You brought down Elder Old Gavel. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
🛡️ Roman, Landon, Fabián, Daniyar and Zoltan met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Roman, Landon, Daniyar, Zoltan are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Landon just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Daniyar just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Landon just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Onni just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Fabián, Zoltan, Ava, Onni and Meera met them at the door — 5 put down. Fabián, Zoltan, Ava, Onni, Meera are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rafael just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Landon, Daniyar, Rafael, Zoltan and Onni met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 barely walked away. Landon, Daniyar, Rafael, Zoltan, Onni are hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Victor just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Victor and Aria met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Victor, Aria are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Victor just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aria just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Victor, Aria and Ziyad met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Victor, Aria, Ziyad are hurt.
